## Overview

This script is the single source of truth for mechanism group definitions. It derives
two complementary classifications of DD genes from the raw DDG2P database and exports
the results for use by downstream analyses.

### The two definitions

| | AltFunc detection | LOF detection |
|---|---|---|
| **Lenient** | `variant consequence == "altered gene product structure"` | `variant consequence` contains `"absent gene product"` |
| **Stringent** | `molecular mechanism` ∈ {gain of function, dominant negative, undetermined non-loss-of-function} | `molecular mechanism == "loss of function"` |

The lenient definition uses `variant consequence` for both AltFunc and LOF. This column
is more inclusive than `molecular mechanism` because it is populated for genes whose
mechanism has not yet been manually curated in the 2025 DDG2P — these genes have
`molecular mechanism == "undetermined"` but retain their `variant consequence` annotation
from prior curation. Using `variant consequence` for LOF captures ~100 additional genes
over `molecular mechanism == "loss of function"`.

The stringent definition uses `molecular mechanism` for both AltFunc and LOF, relying
only on the manually curated 2025 annotations.

### Allelic requirement mapping

X-hemizygous is treated as recessive-like: complete loss in hemizygous males causes disease,
making it mechanistically equivalent to biallelic autosomal recessive.

| Class | Allelic requirements |
|---|---|
| Dominant (AD) | `monoallelic_autosomal`, `monoallelic_X_heterozygous` |
| Recessive (AR) | `biallelic_autosomal`, `monoallelic_X_hemizygous` |

### Per-gene label assignment

Applied identically to both definitions (substituting lenient or stringent AltFunc flag):

| Label | Condition |
|---|---|
| `AltFunc_only` | AltFunc AND no LOF entries |
| `Mixed_AltFunc_&_LOF` | AltFunc AND any LOF entries |
| `LOF_AD_only` | no AltFunc, LOF_AD entries only |
| `LOF_AR_only` | no AltFunc, LOF_AR entries only |
| `LOF_other` | no AltFunc, BOTH LOF_AD AND LOF_AR entries present |
| `DDG2P_other` | in DDG2P but no entries match any mechanism keyword |

Note: `LOF_other` captures genes with disease entries under both dominant and recessive
inheritance. These were previously silently collapsed into `LOF_AR_only` due to
`case_when` ordering — this is now corrected.

## Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(rtracklayer)


theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 12))

mech_levels <- c("AltFunc_only", "Mixed_AltFunc_&_LOF",
                 "LOF_AD_only", "LOF_AR_only",
                 "LOF_other", "DDG2P_other")

mech_colors <- c(
  "AltFunc_only"        = "#D73027",
  "Mixed_AltFunc_&_LOF" = "#FC8D59",
  "LOF_AD_only"         = "#4575B4",
  "LOF_AR_only"         = "#74ADD1",
  "LOF_other"           = "#ABD9E9",
  "DDG2P_other"         = "#999999"
)
```

## Load data

```{r load}
g2p_raw <- read_csv("G2P_DD_2026-06-11.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("DDG2P entries:", nrow(g2p_raw), "\n")
cat("Unique genes: ", length(unique(g2p_raw$`gene symbol`)), "\n\n")

cat("--- molecular mechanism values ---\n")
g2p_raw %>% count(`molecular mechanism`, sort = TRUE) %>% print()

cat("--- variant consequence values (top 10) ---\n")
g2p_raw %>% count(`variant consequence`, sort = TRUE) %>% head(10) %>% print()
```

---

## Step 1 – Per-entry mechanism flags

```{r per-entry}
dominant_req  <- c("monoallelic_autosomal", "monoallelic_X_heterozygous")
recessive_req <- c("biallelic_autosomal",   "monoallelic_X_hemizygous")

altfunc_stringent_mechs <- c("gain of function", "dominant negative",
                             "undetermined non-loss-of-function")

g2p_flagged <- g2p_raw %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    gene_symbol = `gene symbol`,
    hgnc_id     = `hgnc id`,
    allelic_req = `allelic requirement`,
    var_conseq  = `variant consequence`,
    mol_mech    = `molecular mechanism`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    var_conseq = replace_na(var_conseq, "missing"),
    mol_mech   = replace_na(mol_mech,   "missing"),

    # Lenient AltFunc: dominant inheritance + altered gene product structure (variant_consequence)
    AltFunc_lenient   = allelic_req %in% dominant_req &
                        var_conseq == "altered gene product structure",

    # Stringent AltFunc: dominant inheritance + curated AltFunc molecular_mechanism
    AltFunc_stringent = allelic_req %in% dominant_req &
                        mol_mech %in% altfunc_stringent_mechs,

    # Lenient LOF: absent gene product in variant_consequence (more inclusive)
    LOF_AD_lenient = allelic_req %in% dominant_req  &
                     str_detect(var_conseq, "absent gene product"),
    LOF_AR_lenient = allelic_req %in% recessive_req &
                     str_detect(var_conseq, "absent gene product"),

    # Stringent LOF: loss of function in molecular_mechanism (manually curated only)
    LOF_AD_stringent = allelic_req %in% dominant_req  & mol_mech == "loss of function",
    LOF_AR_stringent = allelic_req %in% recessive_req & mol_mech == "loss of function"
  )

tibble(
  Flag              = c("AltFunc (lenient)", "AltFunc (stringent)",
                        "LOF_AD (lenient)",  "LOF_AR (lenient)",
                        "LOF_AD (stringent)","LOF_AR (stringent)"),
  `Entries flagged` = c(sum(g2p_flagged$AltFunc_lenient),
                        sum(g2p_flagged$AltFunc_stringent),
                        sum(g2p_flagged$LOF_AD_lenient),
                        sum(g2p_flagged$LOF_AR_lenient),
                        sum(g2p_flagged$LOF_AD_stringent),
                        sum(g2p_flagged$LOF_AR_stringent))
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Number of DDG2P entries flagged per mechanism category")
```

---

## Step 2 – Collapse to one label per gene

```{r assign-mechanism-fn}
# Shared label-assignment logic: called once for lenient, once for stringent
assign_mechanism <- function(any_altfunc, any_lof_ad, any_lof_ar) {
  case_when(
    any_altfunc  & !(any_lof_ad | any_lof_ar)  ~ "AltFunc_only",
    any_altfunc  &   (any_lof_ad | any_lof_ar)  ~ "Mixed_AltFunc_&_LOF",
    !any_altfunc &  any_lof_ad & !any_lof_ar    ~ "LOF_AD_only",
    !any_altfunc & !any_lof_ad &  any_lof_ar    ~ "LOF_AR_only",
    !any_altfunc &  any_lof_ad &  any_lof_ar    ~ "LOF_other",
    TRUE                                         ~ "DDG2P_other"
  )
}
```

```{r per-gene}
g2p_per_gene <- g2p_flagged %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol, hgnc_id) %>%
  summarise(
    any_AltFunc_lenient   = any(AltFunc_lenient),
    any_AltFunc_stringent = any(AltFunc_stringent),
    any_LOF_AD_lenient    = any(LOF_AD_lenient),
    any_LOF_AR_lenient    = any(LOF_AR_lenient),
    any_LOF_AD_stringent  = any(LOF_AD_stringent),
    any_LOF_AR_stringent  = any(LOF_AR_stringent),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    DDG2P_mechanism = factor(
      assign_mechanism(any_AltFunc_lenient,
                       any_LOF_AD_lenient, any_LOF_AR_lenient),
      levels = mech_levels
    ),
    DDG2P_mechanism_stringent = factor(
      assign_mechanism(any_AltFunc_stringent,
                       any_LOF_AD_stringent, any_LOF_AR_stringent),
      levels = mech_levels
    )
  )

cat("Genes classified:", nrow(g2p_per_gene), "\n")
```

---

## Step 3 – Summary

### Lenient classification

```{r summary-lenient}
g2p_per_gene %>%
  count(DDG2P_mechanism) %>%
  mutate(pct = percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1)) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Mechanism", "N genes", "%"),
        caption = "Lenient classification (variant_consequence)")
```

### Stringent classification

```{r summary-stringent}
g2p_per_gene %>%
  count(DDG2P_mechanism_stringent) %>%
  mutate(pct = percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1)) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Mechanism", "N genes", "%"),
        caption = "Stringent classification (molecular_mechanism)")
```

### Cross-tabulation: lenient vs stringent

```{r crosstab}
g2p_per_gene %>%
  count(DDG2P_mechanism, DDG2P_mechanism_stringent) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = DDG2P_mechanism_stringent,
              values_from = n,
              values_fill = 0L) %>%
  select(DDG2P_mechanism, any_of(mech_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::rename("Lenient \\ Stringent" = DDG2P_mechanism) %>%
  kable(caption = "Lenient (rows) vs stringent (columns): genes per cross-category")
```

### Bar chart comparison

```{r bar-compare, fig.height=4}
bind_rows(
  g2p_per_gene %>% count(mechanism = DDG2P_mechanism) %>%
    mutate(definition = "Lenient"),
  g2p_per_gene %>% count(mechanism = DDG2P_mechanism_stringent) %>%
    mutate(definition = "Stringent")
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mechanism, y = n, fill = definition)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Lenient" = "#2196F3", "Stringent" = "#FF5722")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) str_wrap(x, 12)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(title = "Gene counts by mechanism: lenient vs stringent",
       x = NULL, y = "Number of genes", fill = "Definition") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "top")
```

---

## Step 4 – Export

```{r export}
out <- g2p_per_gene %>%
  select(gene_symbol, hgnc_id,
         DDG2P_mechanism, DDG2P_mechanism_stringent,
         any_AltFunc_lenient, any_AltFunc_stringent,
         any_LOF_AD_lenient, any_LOF_AR_lenient,
         any_LOF_AD_stringent, any_LOF_AR_stringent)

# Add Ensembl IDs
gff <- import("gencode.v49.basic.annotation.mane_select.ensembl_canonical.bcftoolscsq.gff3.gz")
df_gff <- as.data.frame(gff)
dict <- df_gff[, c("gene_id", "gene_name")]
dict <- unique(dict)

out <- out %>%
  left_join(dict, by = c("gene_symbol" = "gene_name")) %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_id)) %>%
  relocate(gene_id, .before = 1) %>%
  mutate(category = DDG2P_mechanism) %>%
  relocate(category, .after = 3)


write_tsv(out, "DDG2P_mechanism_definitions.tsv")

cat("Exported", nrow(out), "genes to DDG2P_mechanism_definitions.tsv\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(names(out), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```
